commit_subject: fix(import): a PDF résumé in three or more columns imports a column at a time, left to right, not two of them interleaved (R2-148-b)
commit_body:
Cause: pdfPageBlocks found one gutter per run of rows and split the page there into a left and a right block. On a page in three columns one of those blocks still held two columns, and it was read by baseline across both, so their lines came back interleaved.

Fix: each side of a split is passed through pdfPageBlocks again, and every block it returns is marked as a column's. A side that is one column comes back as one block, so a two-column page reads as before. A side that holds two columns is split at its own gutter by the same tests (GUTTER, MIN_COLUMN, isTwoColumns). The recursion ends because both sides of a split hold lines, so each call gets fewer items than the one before.

Test: tests/unit/import-pdf-columns.unit.mjs has a three-column page in two item orders, so the first gutter found is once the left one and once the right one. Both read left to right, one column at a time, and read into a résumé with the contacts, then the skills and languages sections. Without the change the other two columns come back interleaved.
notes: Confirmed at d11d5a0: pdfPageBlocks split each run of rows at a single gutter (one `at`) into exactly two blocks, so a three-column page had two of its columns interleaved. The fix generalises this to N columns with a small change: it runs pdfPageBlocks again on each side. The heuristics for when to split are unchanged. A side with fewer than 8 text items, no candidate 60pt from both of its edges, or runs that fail isTwoColumns stays one block. So a two-column page's side and main columns are not split again: I traced the existing SIDE/MAIN fixture, and in the main column the only candidate (x 470, its date) gives runs that fail isTwoColumns. Stacked on R2-148-c, which touches the same file. The patch's base already contains R2-148-c and the two do not overlap: this change is at lines 149-186 and a comment around line 279. No docs/knowledge line describes the two-column limit, so no doc was changed. No product call was needed.
reviewed: Bug real at d11d5a0 (one gutter, two blocks; a side holding two columns read by baseline); traced both new cases by hand: base picks gutter 219.5 / 399.5 and interleaves B+C / A+B (fail), patched recursion splits the 8-/9-item side at its own gutter (pass), résumé case gives skills+languages; recursion only runs after a split, so one-column pages are unchanged, terminates (isTwoColumns needs lines on both sides); Sidebar side (chips/space-between rows shared, candidates <60pt from edge) and main (shared title/date rows reset streaks) do not re-split; applies cleanly on d11d5a0+R2-148-c; no a11y/locale/docs; added the Sidebar/Compact round trip (99-import-roundtrip-columns) and 99-import-roundtrip to other_tests as the regression guards.
